description: This file defines a custom module for the Odoo (formerly OpenERP) platform, adding margin and financial analysis calculations to product data, including methods for computing margins, turnover, costs, and related financial metrics.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: An extension of the 'product.product' model adding margin and financial calculation functionalities.

methods.name: _product_margin
methods.description: Computes various margin and financial metrics for products based on invoice data and date ranges.
